SELECT d.id, l.store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.marketplace, s.currency, l.seller_sku, l.title, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, d.length_cm, d.width_cm, d.height_cm, d.weight_kg, d.source, d.platform_tier, d.platform_fee FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = l.material_id LEFT JOIN ecom_fba_item_dim d ON d.store_id = l.store_id AND d.seller_sku = l.seller_sku WHERE l.fulfillment = 'PLATFORM' AND l.status <> 'DELETED' AND s.platform = 'AMAZON' AND l.store_id = #{storeId} AND d.id IS NULL
AND (l.seller_sku LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR l.title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY l.store_id, l.seller_sku
mapper.sql: SELECT o.store_id, o.platform_order_no, oi.seller_sku, SUM(oi.qty) AS qty FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.fulfillment = 'PLATFORM' AND o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY o.store_id, o.platform_order_no, oi.seller_sku
mapper.select: SELECT a.store_id, a.seller_sku, COUNT(*) AS order_count, SUM(q.qty) AS qty, SUM(a.fee) AS actual_fee FROM ( SELECT u.store_id, u.platform_order_no, u.seller_sku, SUM(u.fee) AS fee FROM ( SELECT st.store_id, si.platform_order_no, si.seller_sku, -si.amount AS fee FROM ecom_settlement_item si JOIN ecom_settlement st ON st.id = si.settlement_id WHERE AND si.seller_sku IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT g.store_id, g.platform_order_no, q2.seller_sku, g.fee * q2.qty / t.total_qty AS fee FROM ( SELECT st.store_id, si.platform_order_no, -SUM(si.amount) AS fee FROM ecom_settlement_item si JOIN ecom_settlement st ON st.id = si.settlement_id WHERE AND si.seller_sku IS NULL GROUP BY st.store_id, si.platform_order_no ) g JOIN () q2 ON q2.store_id = g.store_id AND q2.platform_order_no = g.platform_order_no JOIN ( SELECT o.store_id, o.platform_order_no, SUM(oi.qty) AS total_qty FROM ecom_order o JOIN ecom_order_item oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.fulfillment = 'PLATFORM' AND o.store_id = #{storeId} GROUP BY o.store_id, o.platform_order_no ) t ON t.store_id = g.store_id AND t.platform_order_no = g.platform_order_no WHERE t.total_qty > 0 ) u GROUP BY u.store_id, u.platform_order_no, u.seller_sku ) a JOIN () q ON q.store_id = a.store_id AND q.platform_order_no = a.platform_order_no AND q.seller_sku = a.seller_sku WHERE q.qty > 0 GROUP BY a.store_id, a.seller_sku

SELECT l.store_id, s.name AS store_name, s.marketplace, s.currency, l.seller_sku, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, d.length_cm, d.width_cm, d.height_cm, d.weight_kg, d.platform_fee FROM ecom_listing l JOIN ecom_store s ON s.id = l.store_id LEFT JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = l.material_id LEFT JOIN ecom_fba_item_dim d ON d.store_id = l.store_id AND d.seller_sku = l.seller_sku WHERE s.platform = 'AMAZON' AND l.store_id = #{storeId}
